result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to content being cut off at the screen edge and inconsistent card sizing in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name and delivery cost partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container or card width so content is either fully visible or clearly indicates scrollability (e.g., partial card peek should be more pronounced or content truncated with ellipsis properly).

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a text cutoff error rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis (...) to truncated text or ensure full name is visible on scroll.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white and blends into the light background areas of the food image, reducing visibility.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle background circle or shadow behind the icon to improve contrast against varying image backgrounds.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the navigation bar, showing only a partial image with no visible text or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding/margin above the bottom navigation bar or lazy-load content so cards are not awkwardly clipped mid-scroll.

issues.description: Category filter pills (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) and the last one is cut off at the right edge of the screen, suggesting more categories exist but visual cue for scrolling is minimal.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or arrow indicator at the edge to signal horizontal scrollability.
